Its predecessor landed: PR #22016 (the OSV fix for #22013) MERGED as `289ff6d4` 2026-10-06T21:13Z, so the parked section in the PR body (landing-operations §C, written 2026-10-06T20:38Z) released and this seat ran the one sanctioned `update-branch` (REST 202, `expected_head_sha` = the full `95c510eb…`): new head **`fab444b4`** = merge of `main` `289ff6d4` into `95c510eb`, diff content byte-identical to the reviewed one (6580 +/− lines, equal hash). ## Notes

- Job description: `references/lanes/skills.md`. Write paths (verified this shift): `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name`; `--ack-through=ID` for body refreshes), `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (labels on PRs too, by PR number), `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` (`--title-file` / `--body-file` / `--label`), `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (`issue_patch`, `comment_edit`, `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, `pr_request_reviewers`); route `dispatch`; ⛔ no MCP write. Bare REST, per `rest-channel.md`: `PUT .../pulls/{n}/update-branch` (used once this shift: 202 `Updating pull request branch.`, head moved within seconds, merge commit committed by GitHub). CI re-runs: MCP `actions_run_trigger rerun_failed_jobs` answers 201 for the seat (REST 403).
- Landing: Tier S = at-tier `## Contract review` PASS in seat, then `check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0 + `check-governed-merges --pr N` exit 3 reading Tier S, then the relay flip; `check-governed-merges` also reads the 5000-line human-merge threshold. The ready flip re-triggers the label-sensitive `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, so a PR with auto-merge armed enqueues only after that re-run completes (observed 9 minutes on PR #22000) — expected, not a failed arm.
- Predecessor-dependent PR (landing-operations §C), as practised on #22002: the body carries the expected-red list (check name, run, error signature) and the release condition; after the predecessor merges, one `update-branch`, then a successor `## Contract review` naming the new head (the diff compared +/− line by line against the reviewed one; `index` blob ids may move when `main` edited the same files elsewhere), then the Tier terminal continues. `mergeable_state` reads `unstable` while a non-required check is red and `blocked` on a draft with checks pending.
- Liveness baseline measured this shift (`mode:subagent`, S/M governed-text cards): dispatch → draft PR 32 / 35 / 49 minutes; the 45-minute probe threshold held without a probe. Queue latency observed: enqueue → MERGED 27 and 24 minutes with 2–3 entries ahead; after PR #22033 the merge-group checkouts no longer hit a wall (PRs #22031, #22035, #22016 landed in sequence).
- Platform readings this shift: (1) a relay `issue_patch` carrying `body` on a PR number stores the bytes identical — no footer appended; (2) `Validate Package Dependencies` is path-filtered — a PR that only removes a `package.json` `scripts` line triggers it and inherited `main`'s OSV red (#22013, now fixed); (3) a type-check lane could be cancelled at `Checkout repository` by a ten-minute wall with no test body run — the one re-run case, root-caused as the all-refs full-history fetch (#22020, fixed by #22033); (4) `pm:seat` `list_issues` with `body` in `fields` overflows the tool result, and MCP multi-label `list_issues` is a union — REST `labels=a,b` for AND; (5) a shell variable holding backticked text expands them when double-quoted — claim text goes through files, never variables.
- Timers: Routine `trig_01AGpv4wMw88KexCH41wPrGH`; one accelerator live, `trig_015kXjuAo7R4qgc6gDLha2U8` (armed at 2026-10-06T21:18Z with a 50-minute delay, to read the new head's checks); the earlier accelerators of this shift are spent or deleted. Standby relies on the Routine, the accelerator and the PR #22002 subscription (PR #22016's subscription ended with its merge).
